title: acer negundo var. interior
intro: Acer negundo var. interior, commonly known as the interior boxelder, is a variety of the boxelder tree native to North America. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including its potential to lower cholesterol levels and reduce inflammation. The interior boxelder has been traditionally used for its therapeutic actions, such as reducing fever and alleviating respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of the interior boxelder include flavonoids and terpenoids, which are believed to contribute to its medicinal properties.
